findings.title: Cleanup ticker interval changed from 10 minutes to 1 minute
findings.body: The cleanup loop now runs every minute instead of every 10 minutes. The PR description does not mention this. It looks like a debugging leftover. All cleanup jobs (snapshots, dashboard versions, annotations, query history) will hit the database 10x more often. Combined with a 9-minute job timeout, runs can overlap with the ticker. Revert to 10 minutes.

findings.title: Debug logging at Error level with full ID lists
findings.body: Each batch logs at Error level, including the whole ids slice (up to batch size, potentially tens of thousands of IDs), the condition and a nil err. This runs on every batch of every cleanup cycle. It floods error logs and triggers false alerts. It also logs 'cleaned ...' at error level even on success. The same pattern repeats at lines 537, 554, 557, 576 and 579. Remove these logs or use Debug without the ID list.

findings.title: SQLite parameter limit check uses configured batch size, not the actual id count
findings.body: The 999-parameter limit is checked against the configured batch size, but the real concern is how many IDs are in the batch. This is only a heuristic. Also, the MaxCount path uses LimitOffset, which can return fewer IDs. A batch size of 999 or less is fine, but the inlined-ID branch depends on configuration rather than on len(ids). Use len(ids) for robustness.

findings.title: Orphan tag condition: unqualified annotation_id and no ORDER BY in fetch
findings.body: The condition `NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM annotation a WHERE annotation_id = a.id)` sits in a query on annotation_tag. The column resolves via the outer scope, so it works, but it is fragile. More importantly, the whole orphan scan is re-run for every batch, as before. The semantics are unchanged, but the unbounded LIMIT is appended after the NOT EXISTS clause without ORDER BY, so batch selection is nondeterministic.

findings.title: Large test inserts 40k rows per backend with a 32767 batch
findings.body: The batch-size test creates 40003 annotations and 80k tags. With the SQLite inline branch this covers the limit. However, no test exercises the non-SQLite placeholder path with large batches or the concurrent-insert scenario that motivated the change, so the deadlock fix is untested.
